lines.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓，冰甲龙的步履沉重而缓慢。
lines.en: Crunch, crunch, Antarctopelta's steps are heavy and slow.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙的尾巴扫过地面，发出尖锐的摩擦声。
lines.en: Antarctopelta's tail scrapes the ground, making a sharp rubbing sound.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在阳光下闪耀着冰冷的光泽。
lines.en: Its scales glimmer with a cold sheen in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 粗重的骨头互相碰撞，发出清脆的声音。
lines.en: The bones rattle together, making a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地移动，仿佛整个世界都在承受它的重量。
lines.en: It moves slowly, as if the whole world bears its weight.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙的嘶嘶声回荡在冰原上。
lines.en: Antarctopelta's hiss echoes across the ice plains.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛注视着远方，寻找可能的威胁。
lines.en: Its eyes scan the distance, searching for any threat.

lines.zh: 沉重的骨甲在行走中发出摩擦声。
lines.en: Its heavy armor creaks as it walks.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙的脚步声在寂静中显得格外清晰。
lines.en: The sound of Antarctopelta's footsteps echoes clearly in the silence.

lines.zh: 它缓慢前行，每一步都像是在思考。
lines.en: It moves slowly, each step as if in thought.
Its bony plates clack with every step.
The tail club drags along, cutting a groove.
It punches deep prints into the snow.

lines.zh: 短腿撑着沉重身躯前行
lines.en: Short legs carry its heavy bulk forward.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙静静地站立着，仿佛一座活的冰山。
lines.en: Antarctopelta stands still, like a living glacier.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，骨甲在风中轻轻摇曳。
lines.en: It stands quietly, its armor swaying gently in the wind.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙静静地注视着自己的倒影。
lines.en: Antarctopelta gazes at its reflection quietly.

lines.zh: 它静静地呼吸，骨甲随着呼吸起伏。
lines.en: It breathes quietly, its armor rising and falling.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙在寒风中纹丝不动。
lines.en: Antarctopelta stands still in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，观察着周围的环境。
lines.en: It stands quietly, observing its surroundings.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙默默地等待着，准备应对危险。
lines.en: Antarctopelta waits quietly, prepared for danger.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，偶尔发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It stands quietly, occasionally hissing softly.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙静静地站立，凝视远方。
lines.en: Antarctopelta stands quietly, gazing into the distance.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，仿佛在沉思。
lines.en: It stands quietly, as if in deep thought.
It turns its armored back to the wind.
The tail club rests on the ice.
It blinks once, slowly.
Thin snow gathers in the seams of its plates.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙的目光锁定在了你身上。
lines.en: Antarctopelta's gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着警惕的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes flash with wary light.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙似乎注意到了你的存在。
lines.en: Antarctopelta seems to notice your presence.

lines.zh: 它用犀利的目光审视着你。
lines.en: It stares at you with sharp eyes.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙警觉地注视着你。
lines.en: Antarctopelta watches you warily.
Its gaze pierces through you.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙似乎猜到了你的意图。
lines.en: Antarctopelta seems to have guessed your intent.

lines.zh: 骨甲底下，我盯着你的脚。
lines.en: Beneath my bone armor, I watch your feet.

lines.zh: 冰甲龙的目光中带着威胁。
lines.en: Antarctopelta's gaze is threatening.

lines.zh: 它用警觉的目光注视着你。
lines.en: It watches you with alert eyes.
It turns its head with a clatter of plates.
It stares at you, and its tail moves first.
Shell cracks, hurts!
My tail club cracked against a rock.
Weight crushes me...
Can't breathe...
Armor slows me...
Bone hurts...
Heavy body...
Shell cracks...
My tail club hurts, my tail club hurts.
A seam has been pried open in my plates.

lines.zh: 你的食物在我脚下，滚开！
lines.en: Your meal is beneath me, move aside.
Want my armor? Try me.

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，不然你会后悔！
lines.en: Stay back or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴能劈开一切威胁！
lines.en: My tail can cleave any threat.

lines.zh: 想品尝我的鳞片？别做梦了！
lines.en: Dream on about tasting my scales.

lines.zh: 别碰我，不然你会受伤的！
lines.en: Don't touch me, or you'll get hurt.

lines.zh: 我的体重让我不易被推动！
lines.en: My weight makes me hard to move.
I'm Antarctopelta, don't you understand?

lines.zh: 来吧，让我的尾巴给你一击！
lines.en: Come on, feel my tail's strike!

lines.zh: 我的鳞甲坚硬无比，别碰！
lines.en: My scales are tough, don't touch them!.
Out of my way, I'll push you.

lines.zh: 你顶着我的甲，退了两步。
lines.en: You shove at my armor and fall back two steps.

lines.zh: 躲开我的尾巴，它很危险！
lines.en: Avoid my tail, it's dangerous.

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以推动我！
lines.en: Your strength can't budge me.

lines.zh: 我的体重让你无处可去！
lines.en: My weight has no place for you.

lines.zh: 我的身体像山一样沉重！
lines.en: My body is as heavy as a mountain.
My bony armor can stop you!

lines.zh: 我的体型让你无处藏身！
lines.en: My size leaves no hiding place.

lines.zh: 小心我的角，它们很锐利！
lines.en: Watch out for my horns, they're sharp.

lines.zh: 我的体型让你难以靠近！
lines.en: My size makes it hard to approach.
Find a female甲龙 to mate.
Let's mate and reproduce.
Find a mate to continue our lineage.

lines.zh: 寻找交配对象，繁衍后代！
lines.en: Find a mate to procreate.
The duty of a male甲龙.

lines.zh: 交配后才能获得下一代！
lines.en: Mating is needed for offspring.
Find a female甲龙 to mate.
Reproduction is key to survival.
We are甲龙, we need to mate.

lines.zh: 它绕着同伴慢慢转了一圈
lines.en: It circles a companion slowly.
Grunts heavily
Shakes body, shedding scales
Opens armor, moves slowly
Growls, preparing for battle
Tail cracks rock

lines.zh: 我这一身骨甲，箭都弹开。
lines.en: Arrows bounce off my bony armor.
Bites fallen scale
Scratches ground with scale

lines.zh: 尾甲掉了一截，先收起来。
lines.en: A piece of tail armor came off — I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的鳞片敲打地面
lines.en: Knocks on ground with scales
Locks eyes on prey
Moves slowly towards prey

lines.zh: 张开骨甲，露出锋利的牙齿
lines.en: Opens armor, showing teeth
Tail sweep, splits ground
Tail slices prey
Rumbles warningly
Growls, warning others
Grunts, staring at prey

lines.zh: 用坚硬的鳞片撞击猎物
lines.en: Collides with prey with scales
Tail slaps, shattering rock
It turns its hostility on you.
It charges first, straight at the threat.

lines.zh: 它锁定了那股腐臭气味
lines.en: It locks onto that rotten smell.
Its plates rise; it is about to fight.
Stares at target intently
Threatens, preparing to attack

lines.zh: 我这尾巴一甩，能劈开威胁。
lines.en: One swing of my tail can split a threat.
Aims with scale

lines.zh: 张开骨甲，露出凶狠面孔
lines.en: Opens armor, showing face
Swipes scale across prey
Hisses warningly
Bites prey’s weak point
Slaps prey with scale
Rumbles angrily
Its tail club carves an arc in the air.

lines.zh: 它把尾巴当成斧头举起
lines.en: It raises its tail like an axe.
It estimates where the blow will land.
A tail shadow sweeps across the ice.
All four feet planted, it readies a tail swing.
Roaring and charging at the enemy!
Swinging the tail plating at the opponent!
Splitting danger with the axe-like tail!
Thick armor blocks the attack!
Drop the tail plating as a weapon!
Using weight to overpower the opponent!
Colliding with enemies, shattering defenses!
Hard bone plating protects me!
Going on the offensive, fear no enemies!
Bone plating shards threaten the enemy!
The tail club falls and the ice bursts.
It rams headfirst into your shield.
A tail plate flies loose, slicing the air.

lines.zh: 它用体重把你压进雪里
lines.en: It presses you into the snow with its weight.
Awakens in ice!
Seeking cold lands!
Awakening from hibernation, appearing in the cold!
Residing in the ice plains!
I heave my armored back out of the frozen soil.
Foraging in the snow!
My home is covered in ice and snow!
Growing in the cold!
Surviving in the harsh cold!
Ice and snow are my only home!
The snow peels back and its armor shows.
It crawls out from under the ice.

lines.zh: 化石里的甲片拼回原位
lines.en: Plates from the fossil knit back into place.
The cultivator door opens.
In the cold air it takes its first step.
A small hill appears on the ice field.
It shakes a layer of frost off its back.

lines.zh: 晚白垩世的甲龙回来了
lines.en: The Late Cretaceous ankylosaur is back.
Fire burns my scales...
Tail hurt from fall...
Shell injured by water...
The blast flips up the plates of my tail.
Arrow pierces my scales...
Magic freezes my body...

lines.zh: 骨甲碎裂，疼，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Shell cracks, hurts! — and the starvation makes it worse.
Lightning struck my bone armor; I go numb.
Void drained my strength...
